skill.summary: Manage Linear issues, projects, and cycles with AI-powered triage, prioritization, and workflow automation via the Linear API.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of linear-issue-manager.

- Manage Linear issues, projects, and cycles with AI-powered triage, prioritization, and workflow automation.
- Supports creating issues from code, triaging bug reports, sprint planning, analyzing velocity, and duplicate detection.
- Guides users through API setup, error handling, and example queries.
- Provides detailed reports for triage, team velocity, and release notes.
- Automates workflows using workspace context, priority suggestions, and smart assignment.
